name: DS Cluster D06: Futures Continuation (Rollover + Adjustment Variants)
description: Tests: futures_continuation with LastTradingDay rollover, BackwardPanamaCanal, ForwardPanamaCanal, ForwardRatio adjustments. Uses stock as pass-through.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER D06: Futures Continuation Variants
# =============================================================================
# Using stock asset as pass-through — tests code paths for all enum variants.
# On stocks, continuation is a no-op (single contract) but all variants compile+run.

src = market_data_source()()

# === LastTradingDay rollover ===
cont_ltd = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LastTradingDay,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    i_offset=5
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# === BackwardPanamaCanal adjustment ===
cont_bpc = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# === ForwardPanamaCanal adjustment ===
cont_fpc = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.ForwardPanamaCanal
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# === ForwardRatio adjustment ===
cont_fr = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.ForwardRatio
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title="Continuation Variants (pass-through on stocks)",
    category="Futures",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="LastTradingDay", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="BackwardPanama", color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="ForwardPanama", color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="ForwardRatio", color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(cont_ltd.c, cont_bpc.c, cont_fpc.c, cont_fr.c))
